properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC signing key used to sign and verify JWT access tokens. Must be kept private and be at least 32 bytes long for HS256.

properties.name: jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: How long an issued JWT access token remains valid, in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of frontend origins allowed to call this API from a browser.
